lead.headline: UK tokenization roadmap and Japan's $3B Avalanche migration signal institutional RWA infrastructure is moving from pilot to production
lead.tldr: Today's signals show tokenization shifting from regulatory aspiration to operational reality, with governments and corporates building on public chains while stablecoin settlement pilots prove commercial viability.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why the infrastructure buildout for institutional tokenization is accelerating faster than the market is pricing.

top_signals.title: UK lays out tokenized finance roadmap with projected £33 billion annual boost
top_signals.summary: The UK government has unveiled a strategic roadmap for tokenized finance, aiming to modernize financial infrastructure. The initiative is projected to provide a £33 billion annual boost to the economy by enabling real-time settlement and asset efficiency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The £33 billion projection gives institutional allocators a concrete macro justification for RWA infrastructure bets, reducing the political risk of tokenization mandates in European portfolios.

top_signals.title: President Trump, White House press Senate to advance the Clarity Act while ethics fight looms
top_signals.summary: President Trump and the White House are pressuring the Senate to advance the Clarity Act. This move represents a concerted effort by the administration to establish a formal legal framework for cryptocurrency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The Clarity Act push creates a near-term legislative window that could unlock US institutional capital currently sidelined by regulatory uncertainty, though the ethics fight introduces execution risk worth monitoring.

top_signals.title: Japan’s largest security token platform moves nearly $3 billion to Avalanche blockchain
top_signals.summary: Progmat, the dominant security token platform in Japan, is migrating nearly $3 billion in assets to the Avalanche blockchain. This move represents a significant expansion of real-world asset (RWA) tokenization on a public blockchain.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Progmat's $3 billion migration to Avalanche validates public blockchain suitability for institutional-grade security tokens and likely pressures competing platforms to announce similar infrastructure decisions within quarters.

top_signals.title: Hyundai completes USDT treasury settlement pilot between US and Mexico23m
top_signals.summary: Hyundai has successfully completed a pilot program using USDT for treasury settlements between its US and Mexico operations. This move demonstrates the practical application of stablecoins for reducing friction and costs in corporate cross-border payments.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Hyundai's USDT treasury pilot demonstrates that stablecoin settlement is moving beyond crypto-native companies to traditional corporate treasuries, with cross-border friction reduction as the clear value proposition.

top_signals.title: Tom Lee says users 'starting to see Ethereum as money' as Bitmine adds 27,801 ETH
top_signals.summary: Bitmine has significantly increased its Ethereum holdings, now controlling 4.8% of the total supply. Analyst Tom Lee suggests that the integration of Robinhood Chain is helping users perceive Ethereum as a form of money.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Bitmine's accumulation and the 'Ethereum as money' narrative reflect a repricing of ETH's utility around settlement and collateral rather than speculative beta, though the Robinhood Chain integration remains unproven at scale.

deals.summary: MicroStrategy has raised approximately $467 million through the sale of MSTR shares. This move has increased the company's US dollar reserves to $3 billion while maintaining its current Bitcoin holdings.

on_the_radar.title: The Complete Dive Into Bitget Stocks 2.0 and Its Comprehensive Approach to U.S. Equities
on_the_radar.summary: Bitget has seen significant growth in its stock tokenization offering, with spot trading volume for stock tokens exceeding $1 billion. The platform claims to have captured approximately 89% of the global market share for these assets as of January 2026.

on_the_radar.title: UK Digital Gilt Push Could Help Unlock $44B in Annual Output
on_the_radar.summary: A UK task force reports that tokenized markets could potentially increase annual output by $44 billion by 2035. The initiative includes a specific target to launch a digital gilt by early 2027.

on_the_radar.title: SBI Holdings, Solana Foundation partner to build Japan-based onchain financial market
on_the_radar.summary: SBI Holdings and the Solana Foundation are partnering to establish an onchain financial market based in Japan. As part of this initiative, SBI R3 is rebranding to SBI Solana Global.

on_the_radar.title: Japan stablecoin payments advance with Lawson trial, Netstars launch28m, Japan stablecoin payments advance with Lawson trial, Netstars launchLawson will test yen stablecoin payments in Tokyo as Netstars launches a merchant service supporting USDC, USDT and JPYC.
on_the_radar.summary: Japan is seeing a push in stablecoin adoption as Lawson begins testing yen-denominated stablecoin payments in Tokyo. Simultaneously, Netstars has launched a merchant service supporting major stablecoins including USDC, USDT, and JPYC.

on_the_radar.title: US Govt Moves $297M Crypto to Coinbase Prime
on_the_radar.summary: The US government has transferred approximately $297 million in seized Bitcoin and Ether to Coinbase Prime. This represents the largest movement of seized digital assets by the US government so far this year.

on_the_radar.title: Hyperliquid's HIP-3 markets surge to nearly 50% of perp volume as onchain stock trading grows
on_the_radar.summary: Hyperliquid's HIP-3 markets have seen a massive surge in adoption, now accounting for nearly 50% of the platform's total perpetual volume. This growth is driven by an increase in onchain stock trading activity.

on_the_radar.title: Bolivia Considers Recognizing USDT for Payments Amid Dollar Shortage
on_the_radar.summary: Bolivia is exploring a regulatory framework to recognize USDT for payments, savings, and trade. This move is intended to mitigate the impact of a severe domestic US dollar shortage.

on_the_radar.title: Donald Trump invokes US senator’s death to push crypto bill20m, Donald Trump invokes US senator’s death to push crypto billWith the death of Senator Lindsey Graham and another senator hospitalized, Republicans’ current majority in the chamber has been reduced to 51-47, likely requiring more Democratic support to pass crypto market structure.
on_the_radar.summary: Donald Trump is leveraging current political dynamics in the US Senate to advocate for a crypto market structure bill. The Republican majority has narrowed, potentially necessitating Democratic support for the legislation to pass.

worth_a_read.title: Inference Capital Markets
worth_a_read.note: Galaxy's piece on inference capital markets likely maps how AI-driven execution is reshaping liquidity provision, relevant for anyone underwriting infrastructure plays at the AI-crypto intersection.

worth_a_read.title: Nscale’s £2bn UK data centre hit by grid delays
worth_a_read.note: Nscale's grid delays illustrate the physical infrastructure bottleneck threatening UK data centre ambitions, with direct readthrough to crypto mining and AI compute project timelines and power pricing.

linkedin_post: A lot of people saw the UK tokenization roadmap and filed it under regulatory theater. That is the wrong read. The £33 billion annual projection is paired with Japan's Progmat moving nearly $3 billion in assets to Avalanche. Governments are not just publishing frameworks; institutional pipes are being laid on public chains. Hyundai's USDT treasury pilot between the US and Mexico adds corporate validation that stablecoin settlement reduces real friction, not just crypto marketing. We have underwritten RWA infrastructure on regulatory momentum and it feels mispriced: the value proposition is shifting from compliance cost to settlement efficiency, and the platforms capturing institutional flow will compound before the market catches up. I'd watch whether Avalanche's Progmat migration gets replicated by European security token platforms this quarter, and how that reopens the L1 infrastructure debate. The market is pricing in regulatory risk; I bet it is underpricing operational adoption.
